pairs: portas tuas, et comedat ignis cedros tuas.
Lebanon, and let fire consume your cedars.
because the magnificent have been devastated.
because the secure forest passage has been cut down.
The voice of the howling of the shepherds:
for their magnificence has been devastated.
The voice of the roaring of the lions:
because the arrogance of the Jordan has been devastated.
Thus says the Lord my God:
Feed the flock of the slaughter,
which those who possessed them cut down,
and they did not feel sorrow,
et pastores eorum non parcebant eis.
Even their shepherds did not spare them.”
Et ego non parcam ultra super habitantes terram,
And so, I will no longer spare the inhabitants upon the earth,
unumquemque in manu proximi sui, et in manu regis sui:
each one into the hand of his neighbor and into the hand of his king.
And they will cut down the land,
et non eruam de manu eorum.
and I will not rescue it from their hand.
Et pascam pecus occisionis propter hoc,
And I will pasture the flock of the slaughter, because of this,
And I took to myself two staffs:
et alteram vocavi Funiculum: et pavi gregem.
and the other I called Rope, and I pastured the flock.
Et succidi tres pastores in mense uno,
And I cut down three shepherds in one month.
et contracta est anima mea in eis,
And my soul became contracted concerning them,
siquidem et anima eorum variavit in me.
just as their soul also varied concerning me.
et reliqui devorent unusquisque carnem proximi sui.
And let the rest of them devour, each one the flesh of his neighbor.
Et tuli virgam meam quæ vocabatur Decus,
And I took my staff, which was called Handsome,
ut irritum facerem fœdus meum quod percussi cum omnibus populis.
so as to invalidate my pact, which I had struck with all of the people.
Et in irritum deductum est in die illa:
And it became invalid in that day.
just like the poor of the flock who stay close to me,
that this is the word of the Lord.
Si bonum est in oculis vestris,
If it is good in your eyes,
Et appenderunt mercedem meam triginta argenteos.
And they weighed for my wages thirty silver coins.
And the Lord said to me:
decorum pretium quo appretiatus sum ab eis.
the handsome price at which I have been valued by them.
And I took the thirty silver coins,
et projeci illos in domum Domini,
and I cast them into the house of the Lord,
And I cut short my second staff,
ut dissolverem germanitatem inter Judam et Israël.
so that I might dissolve the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
And the Lord said to me:
Adhuc sume tibi vasa pastoris stulti.
Still they are to you the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
Quia ecce ego suscitabo pastorem in terra,
I will raise up a shepherd in the land,
who will not visit what is forsaken,
et id quod stat non enutriet,
and he will consume the flesh of the fatted ones and break their hoofs.
O pastor, et idolum derelinquens gregem:
O shepherd and idol, abandoning the flock,
gladius super brachium ejus, et super oculum dextrum ejus:
with a sword upon his arm and over his right eye:
his arm will be withered by drought,
et oculus dexter ejus tenebrescens obscurabitur.
and his right eye will be obscured by darkness.
